synth.notes:
Render-and-re-extract model on a 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks, with x=row: H axis = wall row band, V axis = wall column. Selection is read from 0 hole fills; ACTION5 cycles H -> V -> pieces (by min block).
A1/A2 move H or the selected piece by one block row; A3/A4 move V or the piece by one block column; moves stay in bounds. Stateless.
Each piece casts a visible gray reflection across V, plus invisible occluding reflections across H and across both axes. No reflection lands on a block a piece occupies.
New mechanic (step 268): a piece touching the H row casts an invisible V-reflection instead of the gray one. Removing this rule fails only step 268.
Re-extraction: walls/pieces = 4-connected components of own cells plus all 0 cells, ranked by bounding box. Reflections are ranked over visible plus invisible cells, but only visible cells are output. Targets merge when bounding boxes are at most 3 empty lines apart. Untested: pieces blocking each other, and two touching pieces merging.
